pane.resizeHandle: Drag to resize; double-click to restore 50/50
pane.mountFailed: The Typora writing area was not found, so the translation pane could not be mounted.
pane.initializeFailed: The translation pane could not be initialized.
pane.unsupportedFile: The current file is not supported.
pane.noSavedMarkdown: No saved local Markdown file is open.
pane.markdownOnly: Only saved local .md files are supported.
pane.noCachedTranslation: No cached translation exists yet. Run Translate All to create one in the plugin cache.

settings.title: Typora Side-by-Side Translator
settings.uiLanguageDescription: Automatic follows the community plugin display language and then Typora. This does not change the translation target.
settings.targetLanguageDescription: Switching reads that language's independent cache and never sends a translation request automatically.
settings.baseUrlDescription: OpenAI-compatible API base URL, for example https://host/v1. Changing service origin clears session and saved API keys.
settings.credentialStorageDescription: Session mode does not write the key to disk. Plaintext mode survives restarts and updates, but other programs running as the same Windows user can read it.
settings.credentialSession: Current Typora session only (re-enter after close, restart, or update)
settings.credentialPlaintextEmpty: Plaintext storage is enabled. Enter an API key to save it in the community plugin settings.
settings.credentialSessionEmpty: No API key is configured. A key is kept only for this Typora session and must be re-entered after close, restart, or update.
settings.credentialPlaintextSaved: The API key is stored in plaintext plugin settings and can be read by other programs running as the same Windows user.
settings.credentialSessionActive: The API key is available only in this Typora session and must be re-entered after close, restart, or update.
settings.apiKeyManagementDescription: Remove the key from both the current session and plugin settings.
settings.timeoutDescription: Timeout for one translation request, in milliseconds.
settings.paneWidthDescription: Translation pane width percentage, limited to 35-65.
settings.toolbarModeDescription: Choose an always-visible compact toolbar or a hover bubble with cascading actions.
settings.confirmClearCurrentDocument: Clear the cached translation and map for the current target language? Other languages and exported files are not affected.
settings.confirmClearAllCaches: Clear all cached translations and maps for Typora Side-by-Side Translator? Exported translation files are not affected.
settings.eraseLocalDataDescription: Removes plugin settings (including any saved plaintext API key), translation caches, maps, and diagnostic logs, then disables the plugin. Marketplace uninstall alone does not remove this data. Exported translation files are not affected.
settings.confirmEraseLocalData: Erase all local Typora Side-by-Side Translator data and disable the plugin? This cannot be undone. Exported translation files are not affected.

messages.pluginUnloaded: The plugin was unloaded and translation tasks were cancelled.
messages.targetLanguageChanged: The target language changed and translation tasks were cancelled.
messages.fileChanged: The file changed and the previous translation task was cancelled.
messages.translationDisclosure: Translation sends selected Markdown blocks to the configured service at {endpoint}. Review that provider's privacy terms before translating sensitive documents. Continue and remember this choice?
messages.cacheUnsupported: The current file does not support cache cleanup.
messages.currentCacheCleared: The cached translation and map for this document were cleared.
messages.allCachesCleared: All Typora Side-by-Side Translator caches were cleared.
messages.sourceUpdated: The source changed. The pane is showing a cached translation until you refresh it manually.
messages.taskAlreadyRunning: A translation task is already running for this document. Cancel it before trying again.
messages.manualBlocksPreserved: Preserved {count} manually edited translation block(s). Their source changed, so they remain stale.
messages.translationCancelled: The translation task was cancelled. The existing cache was not overwritten.
messages.exportRequiresTranslation: Run Translate All first; there is no cached translation to export.
messages.exportCancelled: Export cancelled. The existing translation file was kept.
messages.sourceFileMissing: The current source file could not be found.
messages.persistedApiKeyInternalOnly: The saved API key can only be changed internally by the plugin.

errors.invalidBaseUrl: baseUrl is not a valid URL.
errors.baseUrlCredentials: baseUrl must not contain a username or password.
errors.baseUrlQuery: baseUrl must not contain query parameters or a page fragment.
errors.insecureRemote: Remote translation services must use HTTPS. HTTP is allowed only for localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1.
errors.baseUrlRequiredForKey: Configure baseUrl before entering an API key.
errors.translationSettingsIncomplete: Complete baseUrl, apiKey and model in plugin settings first.
errors.authorizationMissing: The translation request did not have explicit user authorization, so the network call was blocked.
errors.requestTimeout: The translation request timed out. Check the network or increase the timeout.
errors.responseInvalid: The translation API returned an invalid or incomplete response.
errors.responseTooLarge: The translation API response exceeded the safety limit and was rejected.
errors.responseBlockInvalid: The translation API returned invalid block data: {detail}
errors.markdownProtectionFailed: The translation API changed protected Markdown content or structure, so the result was rejected.
errors.cacheLanguageMismatch: The cache target language does not match the current target. Select the target language again before translating.
errors.cacheInvalidRefresh: The translation cache or map is missing, damaged or unreadable. Stale refresh stopped to protect existing translations; export or back up the cache, then run Translate All.
errors.cacheInvalidExport: The translation cache or map is missing, damaged or unreadable, so export was stopped.
errors.cacheInvalid: The cached translation and map are inconsistent or damaged.
errors.cacheLegacy: The cache uses an older block identity algorithm. Run Translate All explicitly to rebuild it while protecting manual translations.
errors.manualStructureConflict: The document structure and manually edited translation both changed. Stale refresh stopped to avoid mismatching blocks; export or back up the translation, then run Translate All.
errors.cacheCommitRollback: The cache commit failed and automatic rollback was incomplete. Backup files were retained. Original error: {original}; rollback error: {rollback}
errors.taskAlreadyRunning: A translation task is already running for this document. Wait for it to finish or cancel it first.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. No document data was changed. See the diagnostic log for technical details.
